literal: Effort wealth will create; effort's lack poverty having thrust will leave.
translation: Effort creates wealth. A lack of effort will thrust one into poverty.
modern: முயற்சி ஒருவனுக்குச் செல்வத்தை உண்டாக்கும். முயற்சி இல்லாத நிலை அவனை வறுமையில் தள்ளிவிடும்.
explanation: This couplet contrasts the direct outcomes of diligence and laziness. The word 'முயற்சி' (effort) is paired with 'திரு' (wealth), showing that continuous action naturally generates prosperity. Conversely, a lack of effort brings about 'இன்மை' (poverty). The strong verb phrase 'புகுத்தி விடும்' (will thrust into) emphasizes the inevitable and forceful way that idleness plunges a person into destitution.
